name: hax-onboarding
description: Golden-path onboarding for HAX. A SessionStart hook checks for the HAX CLI (@haxtheweb/create) and installs it only when you opt in with HAX_PLUGIN_AUTOINSTALL=1; ships a knowledge skill with the full command surface and slash commands for the top workflows: quickstart (site -> serve -> live URL), site, webcomponent, audit, serve, and publish.
